title: Smallholder adaptation to flood risks: Adoption and impact of Swarna-Sub1 in Eastern India
version: Environmental Challenges 7, 100480, doi:10.1016/j.envc.2022.100480, CGIAR repository copy

passages.note: The sample covers flood-prone districts of Assam, Odisha and West Bengal. Interviews ran December 2015 to March 2016 after the 2015 kharif harvest.
16.7% of sampled Odisha households and 4.2% of sampled West Bengal households cultivated Swarna-Sub1 in the 2015 kharif season. These are sample proportions.
